changes: Adjusted six central control points at each ParamAngleX endpoint to strengthen oblique head turning; shoulders remain independent.
Repainted duplicate jaw stroke on neck SVG/PSD; 34 other source layers unchanged.
Removed accidental ParamEyeLOpen keys from closed-mouth ArtMesh4; those keys made the closed line reappear during blinks even with MouthOpen=1 in v30.

head_turn_measurement.labels: ParamAngleX/Y values, not measured physical degrees

preservation: Frontal default geometry exactly matches v30. Existing 30s motion and original audio bytes, all six expressions and hair physics are unchanged. Neck source texture changed to remove duplicate jaw stroke; 34 other source layers preserved. Mouth opacity correction intentionally changes closed-eye behavior.
measurement_limit: Mouth image-area fit at 30fps, about 33ms uncertainty, not phoneme alignment. Head sweep time origin estimated by the first mouth-area peak. Parameter X/Y labels are not measured physical degrees. Mesh sign test detects new triangle inversions, not every visual artifact.
limitations: This is an oblique-view refinement of frontal art, not a finished 45-80 degree profile. Dedicated nose outline, far-eye occlusion and intermediate profile art remain required.
Independent eyebrow shape, full-body/body/ribbon/hands and VTube Studio tracking remain unfinished.
reference_videos: Earlier mouth/brow/physics/gaze videos retained as historical checks. Current head-turn sweep tests mouth+blink at larger parameter values.
